hoaxes.title: OpenAI will sell GPT-6.1 Terra on a USB stick for offices that work without internet
hoaxes.truth: Made up. GPT-6.1 Terra is available in ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API, priced at $1 per million input tokens.

hoaxes.title: The Sunrise on the Reaping soundtrack adds a 30th track that only plays inside cinemas
hoaxes.truth: Made up. The soundtrack has 29 tracks and arrives November 13, a week before the film opens on November 20.

hoaxes.title: Kirby Air Riders lets players unlock Halloween rewards by scanning real candy wrappers
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Nintendo cancelled the Kirby Air Riders Halloween event over screen freezes and plans to run it again.

hoaxes.title: Samsung's Gemini smart glasses will translate dog barks into text messages
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Samsung's glasses are reported to offer live speech translation and navigation, with no confirmed date.
